title: Graded PDF issue
content:
I am trying to export my graded patterns from CLO 3D to Adobe Illustrator to add final text and markings. However, I am facing two major issues:

  1. When I export a graded PDF, only the **base size** is visible when I open it in Illustrator.

  2. If I use the **'Print Layout'** method to bring all graded sizes into Illustrator, only the **base size** has its notches. The notches for all other sizes are missing or not transferred from CLO.




I have spent a week trying every possible setting and method, but I cannot get all sizes with their respective notches into Illustrator. I urgently need help to resolve this.

Thank you in advance

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: We understand your frustration. This is a highly requested feature and it is currently on our roadmap. While I don't have a specific timeline to share yet, please stay tuned for future updates.

Comment 2: Hi there,Currently, we don't support exporting all grading sizes into a single PDF. To ensure you have the full information for each size, please export them individually, one by one.
Reply 1: Hi,Thank you for your response. However, I must express that exporting each size individually is an extremely time-consuming and labor-intensive workaround, especially when working with a high number of grading sizes. This manual process significantly increases the risk of human error and slows down our production workflow.As a professional user, I believe a "Single PDF Export for all grading sizes" (either as nested lines or layered PDF) is a fundamental requirement for a modern 3D fashion design software.Could you please provide information on the following:Is there a plan to include a "Nested PDF Export" or "Multi-size PDF" feature in the upcoming 2026 updates?Is this feature currently on your development roadmap (R&D stage)?This improvement would save us hours of repetitive work. Looking forward to your updates.
content_description: This web page aims to provide solutions for exporting all graded pattern sizes with complete notches from CLO 3D to Adobe Illustrator for final editing.
